skill_name: Imagine you are given a project to build a GPT model. What techniques would you use to evaluate the model?
workflow: When evaluating a GPT model, I would use a combination of quantitative and qualitative techniques. Quantitative methods such as perplexity, Bleu scores, and cross-entropy would be used to measure the model's performance and accuracy. Qualitative methods such as qualitative analysis of the generated output or conversations with the model would be used to assess the model's natural language understanding and the fluency of its responses.
